description: Find the composers, editors, arrangers and performers of IMSLP by name. The library addresses a person by a category, written 'Category:Surname, Forename', and that is what list_person_works and get_person take. A name is written the library's own way, so searching finds it where guessing at the spelling does not. Some rows stand for another category rather than for a person: the library keeps a redirect for a name spelled differently, and 'redirect_to' names the category it leads to. Follow it rather than reading works under the redirect, which holds none. IMSLP publishes no count of what a search matched, so 'total' is always null. When you show a person to a user, credit IMSLP and link the page.

offset.description: Rows to skip, using the 'next_offset' a previous answer named.

query.description: What to look for among the people of the library. Words are matched across the page, not only titles.

name: search_people

has_more.description: True when the library named an offset to continue from.

next_offset.description: The offset to read on from, as the library named it. Null when it named none.

query.description: The search as it reached the library.

category.description: The category the person is addressed by, which list_person_works takes.

last_edited.description: The day the page last changed, as an ISO date.

name.description: The name as the library writes it, without the category prefix.

redirect_to.description: The category this row stands for, when it is a redirect rather than a person. Null for a row that is the person's own category.

snippet.description: Words from the page around the match, as published and free of markup. Null on a row the search summarised with nothing. The library writes its pages in wikitext, so a snippet sometimes shows the name of a file rather than a sentence.

total.description: Always null: IMSLP publishes no count of what a search matched.

title: Search the people
